mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Conditions at Verona City Hall are clear with a temperature of 56 degrees and we are currently under a new moon phase.

The City of Verona reports that on September 10th, officers responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way where a suspect, Luis Aragon-Zaring, was apprehended after a firearm was discharged, though no injuries were reported.

We have a full calendar today, starting with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival and live music at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga tomorrow and trivia sessions starting Monday.
Regarding the incident from September 10th, Verona police successfully took a 19-year-old into custody following a report of a burglary and a gunshot in the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way.
Today's delicious flavor is Really Reese's, and the Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM.
